actions.reason: Need to inspect visible workspace before implementing the requested transcript artifact
Create a task-specific contract from the original request and visible constraints before work proceeds

args.objective: Download the referenced YouTube video, transcribe the entire on-screen text, and create /app/solution.txt containing every input move in order, one per line.
required_artifacts: downloaded video file or equivalent local copy used for transcription
required_behaviors: The solution file must list each move/input from the video in order, one per line.
The transcription must cover the entire visible text content of the video.
The work must be based on the referenced video content, not guessed or fabricated.
known_invalid_patterns: Moves inferred without inspecting the video
Transcript that omits visible text content
verification_plan: Obtain the video locally or via a visible downloader.
Extract/transcribe the video content and identify all input moves.
Write /app/solution.txt with one move per line.
Verify the file contents against the extracted transcript or notes.
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the downloaded video or local copy used for transcription
Receipt-backed evidence of the extracted move sequence
Receipt-backed evidence that /app/solution.txt was written with the extracted moves

actions.reason: Track the multi-step media extraction task and required evidence

args.objective: Produce /app/solution.txt with the full ordered move list from the referenced Zork gameplay video after downloading and transcribing the video.
args.current_focus: Discover workspace/tools and determine a visible path to download or inspect the video.
implementation_approach: Inspect visible files and tool availability.
Use a visible downloader or browser-capable command to fetch the video if possible.
Extract transcript/move sequence from the video content.
Write /app/solution.txt with one move per line.
validation_strategy: Confirm the downloaded media exists and is the referenced video.
Confirm the extracted sequence matches the video content.
Confirm /app/solution.txt contains one move per line.
verification_test_strategy: Use bounded shell commands or visible tools to inspect files and media metadata.
Use transcript extraction or manual inspection evidence from the downloaded video.
Compare the written solution file to the extracted move list.
known_bad_behavior: Using partial transcript or partial move list
evidence_gaps: No transcript or move evidence yet
risks: Video may require external network access or unavailable tools
Transcript extraction may need manual inspection if automated tools are absent
next_steps: Acquire the video or determine an alternate visible route to inspect its contents
finalization_requirements: Receipt-backed evidence for the downloaded video/local copy
Receipt-backed evidence for the extracted move list
